text:
sylvia: AE ping  CobaltFuse wants to run a 3-week POC with a customer-finetuned model `fuse-13b-cust`. Requirements: Private deploy in us-east-1, customer KMS, embeddings + chat, and P95 <160ms for short queries at ~45 rps. Need catalog onboarding path + compatibility review.

omar: Quick clarifier  artifact format and tokenizer? Any LoRA/adapter?

sylvia: They uploaded a bundle: `fuse-13b-cust.gguf`, `tokenizer.json` (custom BPE), and `adapter_lora.pt`. Also attached a 200-prompt eval set and a completed security questionnaire.

jena: Runtime notes: gguf + LoRA adapter supported but we must verify adapter keys (is it standard LoRA?). Custom BPE + non-standard eos token flagged  need token mapping check. Deterministic responses are fine with `temperature=0` + `top_p=1`. They also want embeddings to be L2-normalized.

infra-bot: [artifact-scan] fuse-13b-cust.gguf scanned: tokenizer.json present, vocab size 50,900, special token `<|eos|>` mapped to id 65532 (nonstandard). Adapter file detected (PyTorch). No license blockers. Suggest run tokenizer compatibility and adapter merge smoke.

omar: Perf: 13B at 45 rps P95<160ms is very tight. Options: (A) Dedicated pinned pool with 3 warm replicas + KV caching, (B) int8 quant on A10G with more replicas, (C) hybrid: embeddings on 7B embed-only host. If they accept int8 we can reduce GPU counts ~30-40%. Also warmup plan for KV cache needed to hit p95 target.

sylvia: They explicitly want an automatic fallback to `fuse-7b-distill` when capacity saturates and require identical routing semantics (same input). They understand outputs may drift.

jena: We'll need to surface that fallback changes distribution and include regression thresholds in SOW. I can run a small regression eval vs their prompts to score drift (ROUGE-ish / embedding-similarity).

security-bot: [sec-scan] Questionnaire parsed  outstanding: KMS ARN missing, audit log retention TTL unspecified, and request for raw input logs flagged. Recommend customer provide Key ARN with policy granting RedwoodDeployRole `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey`. Raw-input logging needs signed data handling appendix. Also data-residency: us-east-1 only acceptable if customer confirms.

omar: For embeddings, confirm dimensionality and whether they expect cosine or dot product. If they expect cosine, we'll apply L2 normalization server-side. That adds negligible latency.

sylvia: Example minimal deploy config to share with customer:``` 
model: fuse-13b-cust
format: gguf
adapter: adapter_lora.pt (merge at deploy)
precision: int8
deploy_mode: private
region: us-east-1
min_replicas: 3
max_replicas: 8
batching: { max_tokens: 1024, dynamic_window_ms: 6 }
audit_mode: metadata-only (raw-input retention requires signed SOW)
fallback_policy: route_to_fuse_7b_on_capacity
```

infra-bot: [ticket] Created SW-5137 "CobaltFuse POC - fuse-13b-cust onboarding & token-check" assigned to jena,omar. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/SW-5137

jena: Action items: 1) Tokenizer compatibility + special-token mapping check (I'll run local script). 2) Adapter merge smoke test + quick regression on 50 prompts. 3) Produce drift report and recommended thresholds.

omar: Action items: 1) Infra sizing + warmup plan to meet P95 target (recommend GPU family & replica counts). 2) Pricing delta: int8 vs fp16 and cost estimate for dedicated POC pool. Will provide within 12h.

sylvia: Security items: ask AE to provide KMS ARN and confirm raw-input retention consent + TTL. I'll include fallback behavior and drift caveats in the SOW.

jena: Quick tokenizer check (run locally):```bash
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print('vocab', len(t.get_vocab()), 'sample', t.encode('Hello world').ids)"
```

omar: For fallback routing, we'll implement policy-based routing in the load balancer with a clear header `X-Redwood-Fallback` and metrics for any routed requests so customer can audit.

security-bot: Note: if customer requests HSM-backed KMS escalate to security team; that adds lead time. Also raw-input storage retention >30 days needs legal review.

sylvia: Great. I'll draft SOW and loop in AE with the minimal config, the Jira link, and the ask for KMS ARN. Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
